documentation.manual_scope: V1-V5 fixed profiles; 45-entry stable API; Custom Pareto Builder; V5 hybrid; build/relocation; REU; Turbo16/Turbo32; V4 QS16; integration/troubleshooting

notes: All shipped SMUL*/SDIV* public paths own signed-specific executable paths; corresponding unsigned executable engines are not entered.
Signed ownership validator: 279 checks and 65/65 zero-overlap signed/unsigned executable comparisons across V1-V5.
Signed arithmetic regression: 264,999 multiply calls and 364,533 divide/modulo calls, zero errors.
Same-corpus delta audit finds no signed timing regressions: newly split multiplier paths save 3 cycles; SDIV32_32 is faster in every profile.

Current ACME rerun was not possible in this execution container because ACME is absent and outbound installation is disabled; historical pre-native ACME evidence is retained and verify_with_acme.py can rerun current sources externally.
V2-V4 retain the executable-ZP native SMUL16 kernel; V1/V5 keep the 31-byte normal-ZP contract using private signed arithmetic paths in already-reserved resident holes.

Custom Pareto Builder added for stock-C64 games/demos: total ZP budget, optional exact extra-RAM budget, init policy and routine weights select the fastest certified compatible V1/V2 implementation set at build time.
Custom Pareto selection has no runtime dispatcher and retains the same 45-entry public API.
Default equal-weight Pareto breakpoints are 31/36/60/147/176/221 ZP bytes.
31 ZP + zero extra RAM reproduces V1 byte-for-byte; 31 ZP + optional-init policy reproduces V5 byte-for-byte; 221 ZP selects complete V2.
RAM budgeting is exact for generated private payload, including the exact emitted MATH_INIT helper; generated manifests list every private RAM and ZP range.

Pareto validation covers 12 reference/alternate builds and 50,064 common-API calls, 10,108 direct V2 cycle-parity cases, exhaustive UMOD8, 50,144 SMUL16 parity cases, 25,000 mixed iterations, 10,000 ZP-guard iterations, deterministic rebuilds and 12 resource/config cases.
V5 Hybrid Low-ZP adds a fifth stock-C64 profile while preserving the common 45-entry API.
V5 keeps V1 normal ZP at 31 bytes and imports certified V2 division/modulo/COS/SINCOS paths with no runtime dispatcher tax.
V5 ordinary safe entries retain V1-style optional MATH_INIT; 2,000 cold-load calls across reference/alternate maps validate this.
Sequential calls, including repeated calls inside game/demo loops, are supported; the library remains non-reentrant.
V5 reference private code uses RAM under BASIC ROM at $A000-$B1FF; bank BASIC out or relocate HYBRID_CODE.
DOCUMENTED LEAN FINAL adds a plain-English Turbo explanation and removes reproducible/superseded packaging waste; code, ABI, overlays and deployable REU data are unchanged.
DOCUMENTED LEAN FINAL includes the complete user/integration manual; resident code, overlays, REU arithmetic data, ABI and performance are unchanged from Turbo FINAL.
The common 45-entry stable API is unchanged across V1-V4.
V3/V4 additionally expose six stateful Turbo16/Turbo32 BEGIN/CALL/END entries.
Turbo executable-ZP origins and REU storage banks are selected at build time; overlay code is assembled from canonical source with no runtime relocation pass.
Reference and alternate Turbo cycle vectors are identical; relocation adds zero runtime cycles.
Endpoint execution validates Turbo16 at $02/$8F, Turbo32 at $02/$0F, V3 banks $06/$07 and V4 banks $FE/$FF.
Fast exact independently derived ISQRT32 remains active; V4 uses 512 resident square-table bytes at $9800-$99FF.
